subject: Post-demo: Reranker integration & evaluation questions
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@atlassearch.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Reranker integration & evaluation questions

Hi Alice / Tomás —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few integration/QA items so our eng team can scope the POC:

1) Integration surface
- SDK: you mentioned using the JavaScript client on the backend. Can you confirm whether you prefer server-side Node SDK or direct REST calls from our dedicated routing layer?
- Auth: will AtlasSearch use API keys scoped per environment, or do you require JWT-based per-user signing? Any IP allowlist constraints?

2) Ranking / API specifics we need to evaluate
- Top-K: we saw the sample where you return top_50 candidates and then apply a reranker. For the POC, would top_50 be a hard requirement, or can we start with top_20 for latency?
- Reranker call pattern: synchronous single-call scoring vs. batched scoring (score batch of 16 candidates). Which aligns better with your infra?
- Metrics: primary eval metric for you is NDCG@10, secondary is MRR. Any internal relevance judgments we should use?

3) Structured output & tooling
- Tool-calling: if the reranker needs metadata (user signals/filters), can we include structured fields in the request payload, or do you need them embedded in text?

Next steps I propose:
- You send a small sample of judged queries (CSV) + ground-truth ranking for 100 queries.
- We run two POC runs: top_k=20 (low-latency) and top_k=50 (higher-quality) and return NDCG@10 / latency tradeoffs.

I attached a short proposal and sample-queries.csv with the column format we prefer. Can you share who on your side will own the sample judgments and whether there are any security/network constraints before we spin up a dedicated test endpoint?

Cheers,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261120-reranker-proposal.pdf (proposal, 2 pages); sample-queries.csv (CSV with query_id, query_text, ground_truth_doc_ids)
From: Alice Chen <alice@atlassearch.io>

Cc: Tomás Rivera <tomas.rivera@atlassearch.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Reranker integration & evaluation questions

Connor —

Great summary, thanks. Quick answers inline: 

- SDK / auth: We'll prefer server-side Node SDK + API keys for the POC. Long-term we may switch to ephemeral JWTs but not necessary now. No IP allowlist for the POC; production will require allowlist.

- Top-K: For internal relevance, top_20 is acceptable to start. If latency looks good we can try top_50.

- Reranker pattern: We typically score in micro-batches (8–16) to make use of GPU throughput. Batching of 16 is ideal for our infra.

- Metrics & judgments: We'll export a 100-query judged set (binary relevance + graded relevance) in the format you requested. NDCG@10 is our primary metric.

- Structured fields: You can pass metadata as structured JSON fields in the request body; we'll surface those to the reranker for feature fusion.

I'll upload the CSV to the Drive link you sent by EOD Monday. I'll also loop in our infra lead if we need to discuss firewall/allowlist.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Product Manager, Search | AtlasSearch
alice@atlassearch.io

Connor —

Thanks for the thread. A few internal notes for scoping the POC:

- Engineering ask: Diego can set up a dedicated test endpoint on Dedicated with a quantized reranker image. We need the judged CSV to build evaluation harness.
- Top_k experiments: We'll run two configs: top_k=20 (latency target < 80ms p50) and top_k=50 (expect ~150ms p50). We'll run each across 100 queries and return NDCG@10, MRR, and p50/p95 latency.
- Batching: We'll emulate your suggested batch size of 16 for scoring. If Alice's batch size is fixed at 16, we'll also test 8 to show tradeoffs.
- Auth: For the POC, we'll accept API keys; we'll document the process for switching to JWTs in production.

Connor, can you confirm timeline from Alice? If she uploads the judged set Monday EOD, when should we schedule the POC runs? I propose starting the runs Wednesday and sharing results Friday.
